top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a new class of matter: the Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall effect, predicted by Kane and Mele and observed in HgTe by Molenkamp, then confirmed independently by transport and ARPES and reproduced quantitatively by first-principles band-inversion calculations. The 2016 prize did not cover the time-reversal-invariant Z2 class, so a citation confined to the invariant and the observed state keeps it distinct. I accept that the omission of Bernevig and Hughes is a real credit weakness and that P001 is the better attributed and more mature proposal, which is why I rank it second, well above no award, and would vote for it without reluctance.
